difficulty.instructions: The state is a change a user asked a software development team to make. How much work will the change take? Judge only from what the request says.

criteria.low: A local edit: one or two files, no new interface, no change to how parts of the system connect. For example a text, a constant, a condition or a one-line fix.
criteria.medium: Several files in one area, or a new function, option or field that other code uses.
criteria.high: Several areas of the system, a new public interface, a data or schema change, or a change to how parts of the system connect.
criteria.other: The request does not describe a change, or its size cannot be judged from the text.
